name: Sanskriti University Engineering

about.text: Sanskriti University is one of the prestigious private universities in India known for its 360-degree and holistic development of students for better personal and professional growth. Sanskriti University is famous for its world-class education quality with highly qualified and experienced faculty members who impart top-notch education to students. To make students compatible with industry essential skills and abilities there the curriculum of every program at Sanskriti University is industry oriented.

Sanskriti University is situated in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, and was established in 2016 since then the university has robustly grown in the education sector and has acquired a well-reputed name and position. To offer students better career aspects in a plethora of industries Sanskriti University offers multiple undergraduate, and postgraduate degree programs with flexible timings in a plethora of specializations namely Computer Science Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Construction Engineering, Mechanical - Design, Power System Engineering, Structural Engineering, and VLSI Engineering.

Sanskriti University is notified under the UP State Act and the programs are designed to develop entrepreneurial, managerial, and leadership qualities among the students through its 400+ vast faculty members. A degree earned from Sanskriti University is globally credible as it is recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC), a member of the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) and Association of Commonwealth Universities (ACU), UK, approved by the Bar Council of India (BCI), Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI), and approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI).

There are various programs offered at Sanskriti University meanwhile, the university provides BTech and MTech for Working Professionals programs with flexible timings, which allows students from the working class to acquire a technical BTech degree with flexibility and maintain a good work-life balance with their personal, professional, and academic commitments. The engineering degree program with flexible timings is specially designed to assist the working professional in pursuing a BTech or MTech degree without hampering their work schedule.

admission.text: Students who are willing to enroll themselves at Sanskriti University are required to follow the below-listed steps of the Sanskriti University admission process:

Step 1: The application form is available either online on the official website of the university or offline on the university campus. The application form should be filled with the required personal, professional, and academic information.

Step 2: After filling out the application form, students are required to attach all the supporting documents along with it, such as academic transcripts, proof of identity, passport-sized photographs, etc. Some courses require work experience certificates as well.

Step 3: Depending on the course chosen by the applicant, you must appear for an entrance examination conducted by the university or a national-level examination like JEE, CAT, or GATE. simultaneously, in some courses admission is made directly based on eligibility criteria.

Step 4: Shortlisted candidates may be called for an interview or a counseling session (majorly in postgraduate programs). In the counseling process, candidates are independent in opting for the course and stream of their preference.

Step 5: On the basis of the score obtained in the Entrance Test (if applicable) or Interview or Merit in the Qualifying Examination, students are required to pay a confirmation fee in order to reserve their seats.
Step 6: Once the admission is confirmed, pay for tuition fees according to the chosen program and specialization of the student.

examination.text: The examination pattern at Sanskriti University is an assessment to evaluate the overall understanding developed by the students throughout their program. The general examination pattern includes internal assessment and end-semester examinations. Internal assessments may include quizzes, assignments, presentations, and practical exams that carry about 70% of the marks in the final result whereas, End-semester examinations are always conducted at the end of every semester to cover the entire syllabus of the particular course.

These examinations assist in evaluating the overall theoretical and practical understanding of the candidates. The Sanskriti University for practical and technical courses and subjects conducts viva voce or practical exams to develop hands-on engineering skills and better verbal communication. The combination of term-end examination and internal assessment results in the academic score obtained by the student.

placementText.text: The placement cell at Sanskriti University is a dedicated department bridging the gap between academics and industry by offering compatible employment opportunities to students. The Sanskriti University placement cell remains active throughout the course and guides students to equip themselves with in demands skills and abilities of the job market, via guidance and training provided by the university. The facilities of the university include opportunities for internship and placement.

faqs.q: What is the highest package offered by Sanskriti University?
faqs.a: The highest package offered to Sanskriti University graduates is 54 LPA.

faqs.q: How are blended learning B.Tech for Working Professionals classes conducted in Sanskriti University?
faqs.a: Classes are conducted through virtual labs and online sessions. To understand better, watch the LMS tutorial after clicking the tap to get LMS access and click the Play Tutorial button.

faqs.q: Is Sanskriti University approved by UGC?’
faqs.a: Yes, Sanskriti University is recognized by the University Grants Commission (UGC) and approved by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU).
No, Sanskriti University does not offer Online BTech but students can pursue BTech with a flexible timing program.

faqs.q: Is Sanskriti University a government college?
faqs.a: Sanskriti University is a private college that is situated in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh.

faqs.q: Can I pursue a BTech from Sanskriti University while working?
faqs.a: Yes, you can pursue a BTech in the flexible time shifts program offered at Sanskriti University specially designed for working professionals.
